title: A Message with a Price
subtitle: A claim to knowledge is exposed as manipulation
sourceCredit: Chiwoza Bandawe · The Moth Radio Hour, “Confidence Game”

shot.title: An impressive halo
shot.direction: The speaker appears impressive through a controlled symbolic halo, not a supernatural event presented as fact.
shot.soundDirection: Bell chime, paper unfolding and the hum dissolving into clear silence.

illustration.direction: Two ordinary men sit facing each other in a modest warm room with plain chairs and a small table. The acquaintance speaks with one measured open hand; a restrained ochre ring of watercolor light behind his head suggests the listener's impression, not literal holiness. A folded paper corner peeks from the acquaintance's other hand behind his hip. The listener inclines his head attentively. Keep natural bodies, ordinary clothes and an unremarkable interior, no occult objects.

beats.caption: How could you possibly know that?
beats.speaker: LISTENER

shot.title: Leaning toward belief
shot.direction: The listener leans forward and searches the other face.
shot.soundDirection: Bell chime, paper unfolding and the hum dissolving into clear silence.

illustration.direction: The listener leans forward from his chair with both feet planted, one hand on his knee and the other slightly lifted in a sincere question. His brows are raised rather than foolishly dazzled. The acquaintance maintains an even expression while the folded letter stays partly hidden behind his near hip, visibly held by connected fingers. The symbolic light ring is unchanged and restrained, allowing the two human faces to remain the center.

shot.title: The hand held out
shot.direction: A request takes physical form as an open hand waits for a gift.
shot.soundDirection: Bell chime, paper unfolding and the hum dissolving into clear silence.

illustration.direction: The acquaintance extends one open palm low over the small table, plainly waiting for a gift, while his other hand continues to conceal the folded letter. The listener's forward posture has stopped; his eyes shift from the open palm to the paper edge and his mouth tightens. No coins, money or gift change hands. Show every finger attached naturally, with the reach spanning a plausible distance and the same chair positions as before.

beats.caption: A gift would show that you understand.
beats.speaker: ACQUAINTANCE

shot.title: The price
shot.direction: The request for a gift changes the tone of the same room.
shot.soundDirection: Bell chime, paper unfolding and the hum dissolving into clear silence.

shot.title: Recognizing the page
shot.direction: The listener recognizes the handwriting before he speaks.
shot.soundDirection: Bell chime, paper unfolding and the hum dissolving into clear silence.

illustration.direction: The folded letter has become visible beside the acquaintance's body, opening just enough to reveal distinctive but entirely unreadable ink strokes. The listener sits straighter and points toward that actual paper with a small direct gesture, recognition in his face. The acquaintance's open requesting palm has begun to lower. The ochre ring thins at one edge, but no paper is magically illuminated and no private message is exposed for the viewer.

beats.caption: That’s my letter behind your back.
beats.speaker: LISTENER

shot.title: My own letter
shot.direction: The folded letter opens enough to make its ownership clear without inventing private text.

shot.title: Standing straight
shot.direction: His body returns upright. The halo loses its hold on the composition.
shot.soundDirection: Bell chime, paper unfolding and the hum dissolving into clear silence.

illustration.direction: The listener stands from his actual chair with a natural planted stance, shoulders level and one relaxed palm held low in a calm boundary gesture. His face is steady, not triumphant. The acquaintance remains ordinary-sized, sitting with both hands lowered and the letter visible on his lap. The symbolic ring is gone; the same warm window light now illuminates both people equally. No gift, money, threat or physical confrontation is present.

beats.caption: No. There will be no gift.
beats.speaker: LISTENER

shot.title: A calm refusal
shot.direction: He refuses without spectacle. The symbolic halo collapses into ordinary room light.
shot.soundDirection: Bell chime, paper unfolding and the hum dissolving into clear silence.

shot.title: No gift changes hands
shot.direction: Both people remain ordinary human scale; the hand is no longer waiting.
shot.soundDirection: Bell chime, paper unfolding and the hum dissolving into clear silence.

illustration.direction: A quieter wider view leaves the standing listener beside his chair and the acquaintance seated, both hands at rest. The unused open space over the table shows there was no exchange. The folded letter remains ordinary paper near the acquaintance, the room lit simply by the same window. Both are recognizable human beings at natural scale. The listener's calm distance is the resolution; no punishment, conversion, magical collapse or added ending is invented.
